name: SVD-Approximated Iterative Transport Equation for Multiple Scattering
aliases: Interactive Multiple Scattering with Separable Phase Function
Interactive Rendering of Multiple Scattering in Participating Media Using Separable Phase Function
definition: A method for interactively rendering multiple scattering in participating media by approximating the scattering phase function using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and solving the transport equation iteratively on GPU hardware using flat 3D textures.
summary: This GPU-based method enables interactive multiple scattering in non-homogeneous media by approximating the phase function with SVD and solving the transport equation iteratively via texture lookups.
